learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn how working together as a superhero art team helps us plan better and build massive, magnificent masterpieces!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When artists collaborate, they work together! By sharing ideas and helping each other, a team can create giant artworks that one person could never finish alone.
A mural is a gigantic painting done directly on a big wall. It takes a whole team of artists working at the same time to complete such a massive project!
Big art projects need good time management. The team has to decide what happens first, like sketching the outline, and what happens next, like painting the colors.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Create a Giant Family Drawing!
fun_activity.instructions: Tape four large papers together on the floor. Invite your friends or family to grab markers and work as a team to draw a gigantic magical city!

quick_recap: ⭐ Collaborating means working together to share ideas and make amazing art.
⭐ Murals are giant paintings on walls created by teams of artists.
⭐ Planning our time and steps makes big group projects easy and fun.
